# The Skin that roams (generated by roam_sim.py)

Times run from the moment the Skin touches Core B. `2 000` draws per cell. The tether numbers are an assumption of this seat. `[HYPOTHESIS]` every stage time.


## R1 desk Core to a vehicle Core, standby, 5G

Carry `30 s`, tether cable, Core B standby, prewarm no, Core A alive, pause and resume.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 0 s | ROAMED | 156 ms | 302 ms | 307 ms | 369 ms | 35 |
| seconds | 17 s | ROAMED | 156 ms | 302 ms | 307 ms | 369 ms | 35 |
| minutes | 600 s | ROAMED | 156 ms | 302 ms | 307 ms | 369 ms | 35 |

## The distance classes: a Leaf from a C0 or C1 Core to a C2 Core, and back

At C2 the device is the L.6.0 Leaf. It renders locally with its slice decoder. Its own U7 signs. The session moves by one TakeOver transaction. The round trips come from `sim/latency`.

| class | the path | round trip, stage mean | input to photon, mean | p99 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C0, a Skin on a cable | the Core in the room, Wi-Fi validator | `0.09 ms` | 15.4 ms | 19.3 ms |
| C1, a Skin on a 60 GHz link | the Core in the room, Wi-Fi validator | `0.96 ms` | 16.7 ms | 20.6 ms |
| C2 km | 5G cell-site, large Core antenna | `5.0 ms` | 16.5 ms | 21.5 ms |
| C2 far | far validator | `81.2 ms` | 92.7 ms | 103.0 ms |

### Out: the tether is lost, the Leaf becomes the writer at C2

| path | the Leaf before | first pixel p50 | live frame p50 | live frame p99 | frames not live | frames covered by U1 | inside the 40 ms reprojection limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna | asleep | 23 ms | 2.14 s | 2.15 s | 509 | 0 | n/a |
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna | awake | 15 ms | 100 ms | 106 ms | 21 | 0 | n/a |
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna | hot | 0 ms | 18 ms | 24 ms | 0 | 3 | yes |
| C2 far, far validator | asleep | 23 ms | 2.34 s | 2.36 s | 557 | 0 | n/a |
| C2 far, far validator | awake | 15 ms | 180 ms | 186 ms | 40 | 0 | n/a |
| C2 far, far validator | hot | 0 ms | 98 ms | 104 ms | 0 | 23 | NO |

### Back: the Leaf reaches a Core, the Core becomes the writer

The Leaf stays live on its C2 stream while the tether trains. It is a make before break. The time does not depend on the C2 path, because the TakeOver goes through the Core network.

| from | tether | switch complete p50 | switch complete p99 | frames not live | frames covered by U1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna | cable | 203 ms | 206 ms | 0 | 5 |
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna | mmwave | 311 ms | 314 ms | 0 | 7 |
| C2 far, far validator | cable | 203 ms | 206 ms | 0 | 5 |
| C2 far, far validator | mmwave | 311 ms | 315 ms | 0 | 7 |
